content: Amoxicillin-clavulanate potassium is supplied in the following forms: 1. 250 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each white, oval, film-coated tablet is debossed with AUGMENTIN on one side and 250/125 on the other. Each tablet contains 250 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). NDC 43598-018-30: Bottles of 30 tablets. NDC 43598-018-78: Unit dose packaging (10 x 10), containing 100 tablets. 2. 500 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each white, oval, film-coated tablet is debossed with AUGMENTIN on one side and 500/125 on the other. Each tablet contains 500 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). NDC 43598-006-14: Bottles of 20 tablets. NDC 43598-006-78: Unit dose packaging (10 x 10), containing 100 tablets. 3. 875 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each scored, white, capsule-shaped tablet is debossed with AUGMENTIN 875 on one side and scored on the other. Each tablet contains 875 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). NDC 43598-017-14: Carton of 20 tablets. Storage Instructions: Tablets and dry powder should be stored at or below 25°C (77°F). Reconstituted suspension must be stored under refrigeration. Any unused suspension should be discarded after 10 days. Additional Precautions: Dispense the medication in its original container. Keep out of the reach of children.
